# skrifa (fontations)

skrifa 0.44.0 and read-fonts, MIT or Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-MIT`,
`LICENSE-APACHE`), used unmodified as dependencies: og-ui reads fonts for
paragraph shaping with it, and og-cook walks COLR v0 and v1 paint graphs
with its `ColorPainter` (`crates/og-cook/src/cook/font/colr.rs`, the
painter after the trait's documented semantics: brushes in the paint's
space, clips and layers nested, sweep angles clockwise).
